lines.coptic: Ϫⲉ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ Ⲫ̀ϯ Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ Ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲛⲧⲟⲕⲣⲁⲧⲱⲣ.

translations.english: Have mercy upon us O God, the Father, the Pantocrator.

transliterations.english: Je nai nan Efnoti Efiot Pipantokrator.

translations.english: Have mercy upon us O God our Savior.
